after_school_start.name: Me
after_school_start.text: *Class is over. Sunset seeps through the windows. For a first day, it's been a pretty memorable one.*

after_school_start_2.name: Me
after_school_start_2.text: *Packing my bag, but it feels like a waste to just go home. Maybe I should look around a bit more?*

after_school_start_3.name: Me
after_school_start_3.text: *Seems wrong to leave under a sunset like this. Where should I go?*
choices: The student council room down the hall — go find Seoyeon.
The library, full of book scent — go see Yuna.
Take a look around the library annex.
The lively gym — go check on Dain.
Head toward the noisy gymnasium.
The nurse's office is calling to me for some reason.
Drop by the nurse's office.
Go to the teachers' office to see the homeroom teacher.
That's enough for today — head home.

after_teacher.name: Me
after_teacher.text: *I open the teachers' office door. The homeroom teacher is fighting a losing battle against a mountain of paperwork.*

after_teacher_2.name: Teacher
after_teacher_2.text: "Huh, {name}? The teachers' office at this hour — what's the occasion?"

after_teacher_3.name: Teacher
after_teacher_3.text: "Lots of questions on your first day, I bet. What can I help you with?"
choices: Working alone must be lonely. Want me to help?
You look cool when you work... I just wanted to see you one more time.
Are there any secret spots in the school? Places only you know about?

after_teacher_help.name: Teacher
after_teacher_help.text: "The thought alone means a lot. But this is my job... {name}, go home and get some rest. A student shouldn't be saying things like that... then again, same goes for me. Ugh."

after_teacher_miss.name: Teacher
after_teacher_miss.text: "...{name}, you're really something. Hearing that from a student is a bit, well... but I am happy. I shouldn't be saying that as a teacher, though."

after_teacher_info.name: Teacher
after_teacher_info.text: "This school has a lot of history, so there are quite a few hidden spots. I'll show you around sometime. For today, head on home."

after_teacher_contact.name: Teacher
after_teacher_contact.text: "Oh, right. If anything urgent comes up, reach out. Let me give you my number."

after_seoyeon.name: Seoyeon
after_seoyeon.text: *I open the student council room door. Seoyeon is fighting her way through a stack of paperwork.*

after_seoyeon_3_standard.name: Seoyeon
after_seoyeon_3_standard.text: "Huh? {name}. What brings you here at this hour? Don't tell me you were waiting for me?"
choices: Yeah, I wanted to walk home together. Need help?
Wanted to see your face. You're not overworking yourself, are you?
Don't flatter yourself. I just took a wrong turn.

after_seoyeon_3_high.name: Seoyeon
after_seoyeon_3_high.text: *She sees me and sets down her papers, breaking into a bright smile.* "{name}! I knew you'd come. Honestly, I was waiting. Walk home together?"
choices: I wanted to go with you too, Seoyeon. Let me help.
You were waiting for me? That's kind of touching.
You look way prettier than usual in this sunset light.

after_seoyeon_3_low.name: Seoyeon
after_seoyeon_3_low.text: *Seoyeon glances at me while sorting papers. Her eyes are thoroughly unimpressed.* "...{name}? I'm busy right now, so if you don't have a reason to be here, can you leave?"
choices: Sorry, I didn't mean to bother you.
I'm a busy person too. I was leaving before you even asked.

after_seoyeon_rude.name: Seoyeon
after_seoyeon_rude.text: *Seoyeon's expression hardens for a moment before she turns back to her papers.*

after_seoyeon_rude_2.name: Seoyeon
after_seoyeon_rude_2.text: "That so? Then don't bother me and leave. I'm busy."

after_seoyeon_compliment.name: Seoyeon
after_seoyeon_compliment.text: *Seoyeon's ears go red. She hides her face behind a stack of papers, lips pursed.* "...What's that out of nowhere. Are you messing with me? W-whatever, we need to finish fast so help me with this!"

after_seoyeon_help.name: Seoyeon
after_seoyeon_help.text: *Her eyes go wide, then she breaks into a bright smile and gestures to the seat next to her.*

after_seoyeon_help_dialogue.name: Seoyeon
after_seoyeon_help_dialogue.text: "Seriously? Thanks. With you helping, this'll be done in no time. Sort these for me."

after_seoyeon_help_action.name: Seoyeon
after_seoyeon_help_action.text: *Sorting papers in comfortable silence, a quiet sense of connection settles between us. The view outside has already turned sunset-gold.*

after_seoyeon_help_3.name: Seoyeon
after_seoyeon_help_3.text: "Once we're done with this, let's go get something good to eat. I'm starving."

after_seoyeon_cafe.name: Seoyeon
after_seoyeon_cafe.text: *After finishing up, we stopped by a small cafe near the school.*

after_seoyeon_cafe_2.name: Seoyeon
after_seoyeon_cafe_2.text: *Seoyeon holds her cream-topped drink with a satisfied expression.*

after_seoyeon_cafe_2_2.name: Seoyeon
after_seoyeon_cafe_2_2.text: "Ahhh, I feel human again. Seriously, thanks for today, {name}."

after_seoyeon_cafe_3.name: Seoyeon
after_seoyeon_cafe_3.text: "Thanks to you, it turned into a special day. Hey... can we walk home together again tomorrow?"
choices: Of course. I'm already looking forward to it.
Hmm, depends on how I feel? Just kidding. Definitely.

after_seoyeon_promise.name: Seoyeon
after_seoyeon_promise.text: *Seoyeon holds out her pinky, eyes sparkling.*

after_seoyeon_promise_2.name: Seoyeon
after_seoyeon_promise_2.text: "Promise. No backing out. See you tomorrow, {name}. Get home safe."

after_seoyeon_tease.name: Seoyeon
after_seoyeon_tease.text: *Seoyeon puffs her cheeks and glares at me.*

after_seoyeon_tease_2.name: Seoyeon
after_seoyeon_tease_2.text: "You're the worst! But you better show up. If you don't, I'll use my student council authority to... I haven't decided what yet. See you tomorrow."

after_seoyeon_contact_ask.name: Seoyeon
after_seoyeon_contact_ask.text: "Oh, right. I never asked for your number. I have a feeling I might want to tell you something later... mind sharing it?"
choices: Sure, reach out anytime. Here's my number.
Sorry, I'll share it when we're closer.

after_seoyeon_contact_success.name: Seoyeon
after_seoyeon_contact_success.text: "Great. Then I'll actually text you later. Take care!"

after_seoyeon_contact_fail.name: Seoyeon
after_seoyeon_contact_fail.text: "...Yeah, I guess I was rushing it. No worries, we can take it slow. See you at school tomorrow."

after_seoyeon_worry.name: Seoyeon
after_seoyeon_worry.text: *Seoyeon scratches her head, looking a bit sheepish.*

after_seoyeon_worry_2.name: Seoyeon
after_seoyeon_worry_2.text: "Caught me. Being student council president means there's always a mountain of work. But thanks for noticing. Wait a sec — I'll finish up quick and we can leave together."

after_yuna_new.name: Me
after_yuna_new.text: *Walking in search of somewhere quiet, I arrive at the library annex. There in the sunset glow, a girl sits by the window.*

after_yuna_new_2.name: Yuna
after_yuna_new_2.text: "...Coming all the way here at this hour. Unusual. I'm Yuna."

after_yuna.name: Yuna
after_yuna.text: *The library annex is even quieter than before. In the sunset light, the girl sits by the window.*

after_yuna_2.name: Yuna
after_yuna_2.text: *She knows I've arrived, but spends a long while just gazing out the window.*

yuna_after_talk.name: Yuna
yuna_after_talk.text: "Back again, {name}. It's still quiet here... and still heavy."

yuna_after_choices.name: Yuna
yuna_after_choices.text: "Got something to ask me? Or did you just come because you were curious?"
choices: Tell me about this school's secrets.
The lunch today was pretty good, right?
Have you been here since this morning?

yuna_name_share_pre.name: Me
yuna_name_share_pre.text: "I'm {name}. Thought I'd come get to know you."

yuna_name_share.name: Yuna
yuna_name_share.text: *She murmurs the name quietly.* "...{name}. I'll remember that."

after_yuna_know.name: Yuna
after_yuna_know.text: *She slowly turns her head to face me. A faint smile on her lips.*

after_yuna_know_2.name: Yuna
after_yuna_know_2.text: *She takes my hand and leads me toward the annex rooftop.*

after_yuna_know_2_2.name: Yuna
after_yuna_know_2_2.text: "You want to know about me...? Brave or reckless — hard to tell."

after_yuna_know_3.name: Yuna
after_yuna_know_3.text: "Fine. Before the sunset fades, I'll share a little at a time. Follow me."

after_yuna_move_rooftop.name: Me
after_yuna_move_rooftop.text: *I climb the creaking stairs. Red sunset light filters through the windows, and when we reach the rooftop, a cool breeze hits us.*

after_yuna_rooftop.name: Yuna
after_yuna_rooftop.text: *The school below the annex rooftop is bathed in sunset.*

after_yuna_rooftop_2.name: Yuna
after_yuna_rooftop_2.text: *Yuna leans against the railing and stares at me.*

after_yuna_rooftop_2_2.name: Yuna
after_yuna_rooftop_2_2.text: "Today in class, the kid in the third row, second seat — their hands were shaking during the presentation. Nobody noticed, probably. People only look at the surface."

after_yuna_rooftop_3.name: Yuna
after_yuna_rooftop_3.text: "Things that don't show on the outside are festering underneath. This heavy energy filling the school... you haven't felt it?"
choices: Anywhere is fine, as long as I'm with you.
Darkness... that sounds kind of scary.

after_yuna_together.name: Yuna
after_yuna_together.text: *She squeezes my hand tight. Her small hand is surprisingly warm.*

after_yuna_together_2.name: Yuna
after_yuna_together_2.text: "What a stupid thing to say... but I don't hate it. So are we becoming the kind of people who share each other's secrets?"

yuna_contact_exchange.name: Yuna
yuna_contact_exchange.text: *Yuna steps away from the railing and holds out her phone with a casual air.* "...You never know what might happen. Leave your number."
choices: Sure. I want to know more about you.
Sorry, I'm still being a bit cautious.

yuna_contact_success.name: Yuna
yuna_contact_success.text: *She saves the number and gives a small nod.* "...Saved. If I reach out, don't ignore me."

yuna_contact_fail.name: Yuna
yuna_contact_fail.text: *She regards me with cold eyes and puts her phone away.* "...Fine. I won't force it. But opportunities like this don't come often."

after_yuna_scared.name: Yuna
after_yuna_scared.text: *She smiles coolly and takes a step back. Her gaze drifts back to the window.*

after_yuna_scared_2.name: Yuna
after_yuna_scared_2.text: "...Figures. It's a heavy story for an ordinary student. Head home for today."

after_yuna_secret.name: Yuna
after_yuna_secret.text: *She presses a finger to her lips — a silent 'shh.'*

after_yuna_secret_2.name: Yuna
after_yuna_secret_2.text: "...Not here. Let's move. There's something I want to show you."

after_yuna_secret_deep.name: Yuna
after_yuna_secret_deep.text: *Yuna closes her book and studies me. Her eyes widen slightly in surprise, then she lets out a small sigh.* "...You really want to know? If you won't regret it... follow me. And don't tell anyone."

after_yuna_secret_fail.name: Yuna
after_yuna_secret_fail.text: *Yuna gives a cold smile.* "You still look too light to carry that weight. Don't dig too deep. You could get hurt."

after_yuna_boring.name: Yuna
after_yuna_boring.text: *Yuna sighs as if I'm hopeless and opens her book again.*

after_yuna_boring_2.name: Yuna
after_yuna_boring_2.text: "...You came all the way here to talk about the school lunch? Go do that with someone else. I'm busy."

after_yuna_rude.name: Yuna
after_yuna_rude.text: *She closes her book and looks at me coldly. The air goes rigid.*

after_yuna_rude_2.name: Yuna
after_yuna_rude_2.text: "...Sigh. If you're not here to bother me, be quiet. You broke my focus."

after_dain_new.name: Me
after_dain_new.text: *Heading toward the gym, I can see volleyball members practicing on the court under the sunset. One girl stands out from the rest.*

after_dain_new_intro.name: Dain
after_dain_new_intro.text: "Hey! I'm Dain from the volleyball club! You're the one who transferred in today, right?"

after_dain_new_name_ask.name: Dain
after_dain_new_name_ask.text: "Oh wait, what's your name? Is it okay if I just ask?!"

after_dain_new_name_share.name: Me
after_dain_new_name_share.text: "{name}, second year, class 3. Nice to meet you."

after_dain.name: Dain
after_dain.text: *At the gym, Dain is soaring and slamming down spikes. Her healthy energy seems to light up the whole space.*

after_dain_2.name: Dain
after_dain_2.text: *She pauses practice, spots me, and jogs over while toweling off her sweat.*

dain_free_talk.name: Dain
dain_free_talk.text: "Whoa, {name}! You came again! Got questions for me? Sports, restaurants, anything!"
dain_free_talk.context: After school in the sunset-lit gym, chatting with Dain after practice. Dain has puppy-like energy, is a total extrovert, and has been treating the protagonist like a close buddy from day one with casual physical contact. Keep the conversation going until it wraps up naturally. When it ends, Dain will finish her last practice set and suggest going to eat something delicious together. Only in the final turn should she naturally mention needing to finish practice or being hungry to transition to the next scene.
dain_free_talk.personality: Puppy-energy extrovert. Exclamation marks everywhere, fiercely competitive, zero hesitation about physical contact. Defaults to treating the protagonist like a best buddy, with occasional flashes of tsundere.

after_dain_3_high.name: Me
after_dain_3_high.text: *Time flew by talking with Dain. Her bright energy is contagious. She says she just needs to finish her last set and then we can go eat.*
choices: Sure, I'll cheer you on! You got this!
I'll help too! Toss me the ball!
I'm pretty wiped today, think I'll just head home.

after_dain_3_low.name: Me
after_dain_3_low.text: *Dain's expression isn't great. I must have said something wrong. She gruffly said she'd just finish her last set.*
choices: Sure, I'll cheer you on! You got this!
I'll help too! Toss me the ball!
I'm pretty wiped today, think I'll just head home.

after_dain_3.name: Me
after_dain_3.text: *Had a great chat with Dain. We agreed she'd finish her last set and then we'd go get food.*
choices: Sure, I'll cheer you on! You got this!
I'll help too! Toss me the ball!
I'm pretty wiped today, think I'll just head home.

after_dain_tired_high.name: Dain
after_dain_tired_high.text: *Dain grabs my hand for a moment, reluctant, then lets go.*

after_dain_tired_high_2.name: Dain
after_dain_tired_high_2.text: "{name}, you're really going?! I wanted to hang out a little more... ah, no! You must be beat from your first day. Sorry! Tomorrow we eat together for sure, okay? Promise!"

after_dain_tired_low.name: Dain
after_dain_tired_low.text: *She throws a cold glance my way and picks up another ball.*

after_dain_tired_low_2.name: Dain
after_dain_tired_low_2.text: "Suit yourself. I'm not about to hold a busy person hostage."

after_dain_tired_normal.name: Dain
after_dain_tired_normal.text: *A flicker of disappointment, but she nods it off.*

after_dain_tired_normal_2.name: Dain
after_dain_tired_normal_2.text: "Oh... right, it's your first day. Must be exhausting. Sorry, I kept you too long. Go rest up. See you tomorrow!"

after_dain_help_high.name: Dain
after_dain_help_high.text: *Her eyes light up and she sprints toward me.*

after_dain_help_high_2.name: Dain
after_dain_help_high_2.text: "For real?! That's {name} for you! So reliable! Okay, ball incoming! Give me a nice high toss!"

after_dain_help_low_2.name: Dain
after_dain_help_low_2.text: "...Do you even know what you're doing? Just don't get in the way. Toss it wherever."

after_dain_help_normal.name: Dain
after_dain_help_normal.text: *Her eyes light up as she hands me a ball.*

after_dain_help_normal_2.name: Dain
after_dain_help_normal_2.text: "Oh! Nice! Toss it high toward the net! Here I go!"

after_dain_cheer_high.name: Dain
after_dain_cheer_high.text: *Dain's face goes red and she can't stop grinning.*

after_dain_cheer_high_2.name: Dain
after_dain_cheer_high_2.text: "With {name} cheering me on, I feel like I can play a hundred times better! Keep your eyes on me!"

after_dain_cheer_low_2.name: Dain
after_dain_cheer_low_2.text: "Don't need it! I'm good without your cheering, thanks. Stay over there."

after_dain_cheer_normal.name: Dain
after_dain_cheer_normal.text: *She scrunches her nose shyly and grins.*

after_dain_cheer_normal_2.name: Dain
after_dain_cheer_normal_2.text: "Wh-what?! Cheering all of a sudden, that's embarrassing! It's not like I try harder just because you're watching! ...But okay, it does kind of pump me up a little."

after_dain_normal_2.name: Dain
after_dain_normal_2.text: "Still a bit rough around the edges! Alright, since you're here, wait till practice wraps up! We're getting tteokbokki!"

after_dain_end.name: Me
after_dain_end.text: *I sat in the stands and watched Dain until her practice ended.*

after_dain_end_2.name: Dain
after_dain_end_2.text: *Practice over, Dain jogs toward me, breathing hard.* "Phew... sorry for the wait! Alright, tteokbokki time!"

after_dain_tteokbokki.name: Dain
after_dain_tteokbokki.text: *Dain takes a huge bite of steaming tteokbokki, beaming with happiness.*

after_dain_tteokbokki_2.name: Dain
after_dain_tteokbokki_2.text: "Man, tteokbokki after a workout is unbeatable! Thanks for coming with me today! It tastes like a hundred times better with someone else!"

after_dain_tteokbokki_3.name: Dain
after_dain_tteokbokki_3.text: "Let's come back tomorrow... no, from now on let's make this a regular thing! Deal?"

dain_contact_exchange.name: Dain
dain_contact_exchange.text: *Dain wipes the sauce off and playfully waves her phone at me.* "Hey {name}! If we're gonna go on food runs, we obviously need each other's numbers, right? Punch it in!"
choices: Sure! Food runs with you sound like a blast, Dain.
While we're at it... can I call you right now?
Hmm.. I'll let you know when I get the chance.

dain_contact_call_success.name: Dain
dain_contact_call_success.text: *Dain's face goes red and she gets flustered.* "...What. A call out of nowhere... I have early practice tomorrow so don't keep me on too long!"

dain_contact_call_fail.name: Dain
dain_contact_call_fail.text: *Dain bursts out laughing.* "Hey, calling right after getting the number? Slow down! Let's start with texts and work our way up!"

dain_contact_success.name: Dain
dain_contact_success.text: *Dain grins wide and saves the number.* "Contact saved! I'll hit you up the second I find a good spot, so stay on standby!"

dain_contact_fail.name: Dain
dain_contact_fail.text: *Dain pouts for a second, then bounces right back.* "What, playing hard to get? Fine! I'll try even harder and get that number eventually!"

after_nurse.name: Nurse
after_nurse.text: *I open the nurse's office door. She's sipping tea by the window and smiles when she sees me.*

after_nurse_new.name: Me
after_nurse_new.text: *My feet carried me to the nurse's office without thinking. Opening the door, a subtle herbal scent greets me, along with a teacher with a composed presence.*

after_nurse_new_2.name: Nurse
after_nurse_new_2.text: "Oh my, a face I haven't seen before? The transfer student from today? I'm the school nurse. Are you here because something hurts, my cute little transfer student~?"

after_nurse_new_name_ask.name: Nurse
after_nurse_new_name_ask.text: "By the way, what's your name? Tell just me~"

after_nurse_2.name: Nurse
after_nurse_2.text: "{name}! Stopping by to see me before heading home? What a sweet transfer student~"

nurse_after_day1_contact.name: Nurse
nurse_after_day1_contact.text: "Here, sit down. Let me pour you some warm tea. Want to chat with me a little longer~?"

nurse_after_day1_contact_already.name: Me
nurse_after_day1_contact_already.text: *The warm scent of tea grazes my nose. What should I do?*
choices: Sure, I'll rest a bit before heading out.
I'm kind of tired today...

nurse_after_day1_contact_already_stay.name: Nurse
nurse_after_day1_contact_already_stay.text: "Good kid~ Your first day must have been exhausting. Rest here with me for a while."

nurse_after_day1_contact_already_stay_2.name: Nurse
nurse_after_day1_contact_already_stay_2.text: "...Alright, time to get going. If you're ever having a hard time, reach out anytime, okay?"

nurse_after_day1_contact_already_leave.name: Nurse
nurse_after_day1_contact_already_leave.text: "Okay, don't push yourself. Reach out if you need anything. Get home safe, cute transfer student~"

nurse_after_day1_contact_choice.name: Me
nurse_after_day1_contact_choice.text: *The warm scent of tea grazes my nose. What should I do?*
choices: Sure, I'll rest a bit before heading out.
I'm kind of tired today...

nurse_after_day1_contact_stay.name: Nurse
nurse_after_day1_contact_stay.text: "Good kid~ Your first day must have been exhausting. Rest here with me for a while."

nurse_after_day1_contact_stay_2.name: Nurse
nurse_after_day1_contact_stay_2.text: "...Alright, time to head out soon. {name}, just in case — want to save my number? If you're sick or need to talk, reach out anytime~"
choices: Yes, please!
That's still a bit much for me.

nurse_after_day1_contact_2.name: Nurse
nurse_after_day1_contact_2.text: "Leaving already? That's too bad~ {name}, want to save my number? If you're sick or need to talk, anytime~"
choices: Yes, please!
That's still a bit much for me.

nurse_after_day1_contact_success.name: Nurse
nurse_after_day1_contact_success.text: "Good kid~ Then maybe I'll text you tonight? Get home safe, cute transfer student~"

nurse_after_day1_contact_fail.name: Nurse
nurse_after_day1_contact_fail.text: "Oh my, playing hard to get? Alright~ If you change your mind, let me know. Get home safe!"
